youtube_description:
In this episode of Future CFO_DP, Dr. Debasis Pahi unpacks the Wolters Kluwer Future Ready CFO 2026 report and the OneStream Forward Finance Index. Discover why 83% of APAC CFOs see AI reshaping finance, why only 6% of organizations are true Forward Finance Leaders, and what business students must master for the Agentic Finance era. Human judgment remains the final decision.

Sources: Wolters Kluwer Future Ready CFO 2026, OneStream Forward Finance Index, BW CFO World, FICCI CFO Summit 2026.
